title: Thoughts between commands fold into their work group, and a described command reads as its description

source.name: a thought joins the tool group of the tool it comes before

steps.text: One file changed since the last commit.

input.description: Count TODO markers in the README

invariant: A thought that comes before a command sits inside that command's work group, whose header counts only the commands; the thought before the reply stays above it. A command whose agent described it reads as that description, and one with no description reads "Ran <command>".
